title: A dual DNA/RNA-binding factor regulates co-transcriptional splicing through target RNA interaction and modulates splicing factor dynamics
authors: Mukulika Ray; Julia Zaborowsky; Pranav Mahableshwarkar; Smriti Vaidyanathan; Jasmine Shum; Annie Huang; Renjith Viswanathan; Isabelle Pilo; Victoria Chen; Kaitlyn Cortez; Ashley M. Conard; Szu-Huan Wang; Victoria Johnson; Noah Wake; Alexander E. Conicella; Ryan Puterbaugh; Nicolas L. Fawzi; Erica Larschan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究双功能DNA/RNA结合因子CLAMP通过RNA互作调控共转录剪接，涉及TF-DNA结合但核心是剪接调控而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法为实验生物学，无AI或物理模拟，故仅部分相关。
abstract: How RNA splicing events are targeted to the correct genomic locations in specific cellular contexts to generate context-specific transcript diversity and prevent deleterious cryptic splicing remains very poorly understood. We show that a functionally conserved GA-rich DNA-binding transcription factor (TF), CLAMP, targets distinct RNA molecules in male and female cells to precisely regulate sex-specific splicing events through physical and functional interactions with RNA and RNA-binding proteins (RBPs). The prion-like domain of CLAMP (PrLD) and a stem-loop region in the target RNA are important for CLAMP-RNA interaction. Moreover, the CLAMP PrLD domain regulates sex-specific splicing by modulating the dynamics of an hnRNPA2/B1 family protein that regulates alternative splicing. Thus, we demonstrate that a TF targets co-transcriptional splicing to the correct genomic locations by directly linking DNA binding sites to RNA targets and modulating the dynamics of RBP partners that drive alternative splicing.
abstract_zh: RNA剪接事件如何在特定细胞环境中被靶向到正确的基因组位置，以生成环境特异性的转录本多样性并防止有害的隐性剪接，这一问题至今仍知之甚少。我们展示了一个功能保守的富含GA的DNA结合转录因子（TF），CLAMP，在雄性和雌性细胞中靶向不同的RNA分子，通过与RNA和RNA结合蛋白（RBPs）的物理和功能相互作用，精确调控性别特异性剪接事件。CLAMP的朊病毒样结构域（PrLD）和靶RNA中的茎环区域对CLAMP-RNA相互作用至关重要。此外，CLAMP PrLD结构域通过调节一个调控可变剪接的hnRNPA2/B1家族蛋白的动态来调控性别特异性剪接。因此，我们证明了一个TF通过直接将DNA结合位点与RNA靶标连接并调节驱动可变剪接的RBP伴侣的动态，将共转录剪接靶向到正确的基因组位置。
